limits: A hidden-prefixed suffix selects the existing server-authoritative hidden-inclusive ForumStart module behavior.
A suffix outside the hidden prefix selects the ordinary ForumStart view.
The suffix itself does not select forum rows, add query parameters, or grant permission to read private categories.
The observation does not establish mutation or forum-object permission behavior.
